messages:
Maya L: Hey team — quick sync on the Orchid beta cohort. Only 6/20 seats actively using the build; 8 invited but not activated, and two accounts stuck at enrollment (NovaFin, ArgoHealth). Can we align next touchpoints and ownership?
OnboardBot: [auto] Enrollment snapshot: 20 invited · 6 active · 8 invited-not-activated · 2 declined · 4 pending-schedule. Dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood.com/beta/orchid
Jonah P: @Maya L I'll take NovaFin + ArgoHealth outreach. Suggest 15m "enablement triage" for each to unblock. I have Mon/Tue mornings free.
Priya S: I can run a focused enablement session Wed 10:00am PT — 30m hands-on + checklist walkthru. I'll prepare the short deck and a 3-question survey.
Ben R: Product ask — can we add one event to track "first-successful-inference" for the cohort? If we capture that we can show runway-to-value for each account. I can drop a JS snippet to instrument the event.
Maya L: Good. Also flagging NovaFin as a renewal-risk: procurement has delayed signing. If outreach doesn't land, escalate to exec sponsor.
Jonah P: Plan of record: 1) outreach email today (template below), 2) 15m triage call to resolve enrollment or infra blockers, 3) hands-on enablement (Priya), 4) follow-up survey + success check at 2 weeks.
Maya L: Email template (use for NovaFin / ArgoHealth):
```
Subject: Redwood Orchid — quick enablement check
Hi {{first_name}},
Noticed your team hasn't completed onboarding for the Orchid beta. Can we book 15 minutes to unblock and get you to first inference?
Available slots: Mon 9–11am PT, Tue 9–11am PT, Wed 10am PT
If none of these work, please propose two times and we'll adapt.
Thanks,\nMaya L (Customer Success)
```
Priya S: I'll draft the short survey: 1) biggest blocker, 2) expected launch date, 3) one metric that defines success. Will post link here after the deck.
OnboardBot: [auto] Tag added: "renewal-risk" -> NovaFin. Assignee: Jonah P.
Maya L: OK locking owners: Jonah = outreach + escalation; Priya = Wed enablement + survey; Ben = instrumentation snippet by EOD. I'll ping the exec sponsor for NovaFin after Jonah's first outreach. :thumbsup:
Jonah P: On it — sending the first emails now. Will post calendar invites for triage calls once they confirm. :eyes:
